headline: Diamond Hill Is Betting on Veralto’s (VLTO) Resilient Business Model
summary: Diamond Hill Capital, a First Eagle Investment Management company, issued its Q2 2026 investor letter for its “Mid Cap Strategy”. A copy of the Q2 2026 investor letter can be downloaded here.
